newsitem.title: FINLAND: Amer sees clear full-year 1996 loss.
newsitem.headline: Amer sees clear full-year 1996 loss.

text.p: Finnish sporting goods and tobacco group Amer-yhtyma Oy expects the full-year 1996 result before extraordinary items and tax to be clearly loss-making, a company spokeswoman said on Thursday.

"Net sales for the year are expected, at current exchange rates, to reach five billion markka. The group's result before taxes and extraordinary items is expected to be clearly loss-making," she said, reading from a company statement.
In 1995, Amer posted a 142 million markka profit before extras and tax.
It fell to a 206 million markka January-August loss from a 36 million profit in the year-ago period.
